description: This Java class 'InboundMappingOutcomes' encapsulates the outcomes of processing an inbound external message within the Eclipse Ditto project. It manages a list of mapping results, associated message, potential error, and sender actor reference, providing methods for creation, access, and standard object behaviors.

classes.name: InboundMappingOutcomes
classes.description: A final class representing the outcome of mapping one inbound external message, including associated outcomes, message, error state, and sender actor.

methods.name: of
methods.description: Factory method creating an InboundMappingOutcomes instance representing an error for a given message and sender.

methods.name: of
methods.description: Factory method creating an InboundMappingOutcomes instance with specified mapping outcomes, external message, and sender.

methods.name: getOutcomes
methods.description: Returns the list of mapping outcomes.

methods.name: getExternalMessage
methods.description: Returns the external message associated with the outcome.

methods.name: getError
methods.description: Returns the exception error if present.

methods.name: hasError
methods.description: Indicates whether there was an error in mapping outcomes.

methods.name: getSender
methods.description: Returns the actor reference who cares about the outcome.
